title: SQL injection prevention via parameterized queries
description: All SQL queries in the application use ? placeholders with parameter tuples — no string interpolation or f-string formatting into SQL. This is a verified security control (assertions.md §3) that must not regress.
spec:
1. Verify every db.execute() call in flaskr/auth.py and flaskr/blog.py uses ? placeholders with a parameter tuple, not string interpolation.
2. Specifically check: INSERT INTO user, SELECT FROM user WHERE username, SELECT FROM user WHERE id, INSERT INTO post, UPDATE post, DELETE FROM post, and the index JOIN query — all parameterized.
3. Verify no use of f-strings, .format(), or % string formatting in any SQL statement.
4. Verify tests do not introduce raw SQL interpolation patterns.
